patterns.name_zh: 現在完成式（經驗、持續、完成；常配 since / for / in recent years / so far）
patterns.pattern: S + have/has (+ already/long/always) + p.p. …
examples: Since the new library opened, more and more students have spent their weekends there.
In recent years, online shopping has changed the way people buy groceries.
My grandfather has lived in this small fishing village all his life.
